lore: Word on the quay is that a smuggler has stowed contraband on one island of the census. Exciseman Bartholomew may not search them all, only ask the harbour office questions it can answer yes or no from the ledger: which world, which realm, how high the slot, how much cargo. Every question costs a tide. Find the island in as few as the ledger allows, then make the accusation.

lines.sharp: Caught in the fewest questions the ledger allows. Not a tide wasted. The Crown thanks you.
lines.caught: We have the smuggler, but it took more tides than it needed. Ask questions that split the suspects in half.
lines.escaped: Wrong island. While we searched it, the contraband slipped out on the night tide.
